title: Tokyo: man arrested over fake base station said to have cut service to more than 10,000 phones
what_changed: Date corrected from 19 November (ZATAZ's update day) to 7 November, the arrest day given by Kyodo and Jiji; added the 9 November referral to prosecutors. The more than 10,000 figure is now cited to The Star ("more than 10,000 smartphones ... lose cellular service"), and the duration was dropped because sources differ. Status developing to confirmed, validation single_source to corroborated.
